name: sideband-comments-obsidian
description: Document-grounded AI collaboration with shared comments across your notes and VS Code.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:obsidian --external:@codemirror/state --external:@codemirror/view --outfile=dist/main.js && cp manifest.json styles.css dist/
scripts.package: npm run build && zip -j dist/sideband-comments-obsidian-1.0.3.zip dist/main.js dist/manifest.json dist/styles.css
